$comment: This repository is PUBLIC. No real workspace name, capacity name, folder name,
GUID, tenant identifier, region, employer name or email address may ever appear
Real values live in config/environment.local.json, which is gitignored and never
committed. Copy this file to that name and fill it in. Scripts read the local
file and fail loudly if it is missing - they never fall back to these
placeholders, because a placeholder that silently 'works' is how a wrong target

$targetComment: There is NO standing target folder. The authorised target is supplied per
ticket by the GitHub Issue or an explicitly human-approved prompt, and must
be resolved to its REST folder GUID and verified before any write.
The entry below exists so a ticket's target can be recorded locally for the
duration of that ticket. It is not an authorisation by itself.

$isolationNote: Folder-level isolation is ORGANIZATIONAL ONLY. It is not a security, Git,
capacity or permission boundary, and Lakehouse tables do not live in folders
at all. The allowlist in the ticket, not the folder, is the actual control.
Agents run under a delegated user identity and inherit its permissions. Every
Fabric restriction in this repository is therefore an instruction, not a
permission. Do not describe it otherwise.
